correctness.rationale: PASS: The cited half-line Lindblad sink resolvent yields a Parseval decomposition A_{n,K}=B_eta(c)+E_{n,eta}(c). Exterior term nonnegative and its polynomial numerator bounded by K gives E<=K/[2pi n(n-1)] uniformly in c and eta>0. The in-band factor 2 eta sin(k)/(1+eta²+2 eta sin(k)) is bounded pointwise by sin(k)/(1+sin(k)), with equality only at eta=1; any nonzero preparation polynomial is nonzero on positive measure, proving unique far-field loss and top Toeplitz eigenvalue Lambda_K. At eta=1 the full-circle scalar symbol sigma(k) has deficit satisfying x(k)/4 <=1-sigma(k)<=x(k)/4+x(k)^2/8 with x=|exp(ik)-i|². The Dirichlet path Laplacian gives smallest x-energy lambda_K=4sin²(pi/[2(K+1)]); the chirped sine ground-state packet yields exact x²-energy lambda_K²+[4/(K+1)]sin²(pi/(K+1)). Thus both explicit K bounds and Lambda_K=1-pi²/[4(K+1)²]+O(K^-3). Independent 2048-node Gauss-Legendre quadrature and Hermitian eigenvalues for K=1,2,3,5,10,20 verified lower/upper deficit bounds and K=1=1-2/pi,K=2=2/pi. The exact Green-function premise is sourced to Riberi and not claimed as independently proved from first principles; numeric finite K cannot prove asymptotics.
